name: kai-marketing-os
description: Kai Marketing OS — marketing skills, knowledge base, subagents, and quality gates for Cowork and Claude Code.

plugins.name: kai
plugins.description: A marketing team in Cowork or your terminal: 49 /kai skills, 3 marketing subagents, a full knowledge base, and quality gates that block slop before it ships. Type /kai:kai-start after install, or /kai:kai-goal to run an objective to completion.

plugins.name: kai-v2
plugins.description: Kai for current frontier models: the same 49 skills stated as objectives, completion floors, and constraints instead of phase lists. Same knowledge base and gates as `kai`. Install this on Opus 5 / Sonnet 5 class models; install `kai` for smaller or older ones.
